description.content: Data-driven collection covering all 56 reviewed-usable FR-08 cases (51 AI-origin after the human audit plus the 5 student-selected extensions). One iteration per canonical case, driven by FR08-checkout.data.json. Optional phases (second user, second checkout, cart rebuild) are skipped per row with pm.execution.skipRequest. Harness notes: implementation cart state is process memory keyed by user id, POST /api/cart only appends, and no cart-clearing endpoint is documented, so each case registers its own fresh user to obtain a deterministic empty starting cart. The expected total is never hardcoded: it is derived at run time from the cart state the server itself reports immediately before each checkout, which is exactly the reviewed FR-08 oracle. No HTTP status code and no response schema is asserted anywhere, because the API specification documents none for this endpoint; undocumented behaviour is logged as SPEC GAP instead.

One iteration per canonical case, driven by FR08-checkout.data.json. Optional phases (second user, second checkout, cart rebuild) are skipped per row with pm.execution.skipRequest. No HTTP status code and no response schema is asserted anywhere, because the API specification documents none for this endpoint; undocumented behaviour is logged as SPEC GAP instead.

description.content: Data-driven collection covering all 56 reviewed-usable FR-08 cases (51 AI-origin after the human audit plus the 5 student-selected extensions). One iteration per canonical case, driven by FR08-checkout.data.json. Optional phases (second user, second checkout, cart rebuild) are skipped per row with pm.execution.skipRequest. Harness notes: implementation cart state is process memory keyed by user id, POST /api/cart only appends, and no cart-clearing endpoint is documented, so each case registers its own fresh user to obtain a deterministic empty starting cart. The expected total is never hardcoded: it is derived at run time from the cart state the server itself reports immediately before each checkout, which is exactly the reviewed FR-08 oracle. No HTTP status code and no response schema is asserted anywhere, because the API specification documents none for this endpoint; undocumented behaviour is logged as SPEC GAP instead.

description.content: Data-driven collection covering all 56 reviewed-usable FR-08 cases (51 AI-origin after the human audit plus the 5 student-selected extensions). One iteration per canonical case, driven by FR08-checkout.data.json. Optional phases (second user, second checkout, cart rebuild) are skipped per row with pm.execution.skipRequest. Harness notes: implementation cart state is process memory keyed by user id, POST /api/cart only appends, and no cart-clearing endpoint is documented, so each case registers its own fresh user to obtain a deterministic empty starting cart. The expected total is never hardcoded: it is derived at run time from the cart state the server itself reports immediately before each checkout, which is exactly the reviewed FR-08 oracle. No HTTP status code and no response schema is asserted anywhere, because the API specification documents none for this endpoint; undocumented behaviour is logged as SPEC GAP instead.

One iteration per canonical case, driven by FR08-checkout.data.json. Optional phases (second user, second checkout, cart rebuild) are skipped per row with pm.execution.skipRequest. No HTTP status code and no response schema is asserted anywhere, because the API specification documents none for this endpoint; undocumented behaviour is logged as SPEC GAP instead.

description.content: Data-driven collection covering all 56 reviewed-usable FR-08 cases (51 AI-origin after the human audit plus the 5 student-selected extensions). One iteration per canonical case, driven by FR08-checkout.data.json. Optional phases (second user, second checkout, cart rebuild) are skipped per row with pm.execution.skipRequest. Harness notes: implementation cart state is process memory keyed by user id, POST /api/cart only appends, and no cart-clearing endpoint is documented, so each case registers its own fresh user to obtain a deterministic empty starting cart. The expected total is never hardcoded: it is derived at run time from the cart state the server itself reports immediately before each checkout, which is exactly the reviewed FR-08 oracle. No HTTP status code and no response schema is asserted anywhere, because the API specification documents none for this endpoint; undocumented behaviour is logged as SPEC GAP instead.

description.content: Data-driven collection covering all 56 reviewed-usable FR-08 cases (51 AI-origin after the human audit plus the 5 student-selected extensions). One iteration per canonical case, driven by FR08-checkout.data.json. Optional phases (second user, second checkout, cart rebuild) are skipped per row with pm.execution.skipRequest. Harness notes: implementation cart state is process memory keyed by user id, POST /api/cart only appends, and no cart-clearing endpoint is documented, so each case registers its own fresh user to obtain a deterministic empty starting cart. The expected total is never hardcoded: it is derived at run time from the cart state the server itself reports immediately before each checkout, which is exactly the reviewed FR-08 oracle. No HTTP status code and no response schema is asserted anywhere, because the API specification documents none for this endpoint; undocumented behaviour is logged as SPEC GAP instead.

No HTTP status code and no response schema is asserted anywhere, because the API specification documents none for this endpoint; undocumented behaviour is logged as SPEC GAP instead.

One iteration per canonical case, driven by FR08-checkout.data.json. Optional phases (second user, second checkout, cart rebuild) are skipped per row with pm.execution.skipRequest. No HTTP status code and no response schema is asserted anywhere, because the API specification documents none for this endpoint; undocumented behaviour is logged as SPEC GAP instead.

description.content: Data-driven collection covering all 56 reviewed-usable FR-08 cases (51 AI-origin after the human audit plus the 5 student-selected extensions). One iteration per canonical case, driven by FR08-checkout.data.json. Optional phases (second user, second checkout, cart rebuild) are skipped per row with pm.execution.skipRequest. Harness notes: implementation cart state is process memory keyed by user id, POST /api/cart only appends, and no cart-clearing endpoint is documented, so each case registers its own fresh user to obtain a deterministic empty starting cart. The expected total is never hardcoded: it is derived at run time from the cart state the server itself reports immediately before each checkout, which is exactly the reviewed FR-08 oracle. No HTTP status code and no response schema is asserted anywhere, because the API specification documents none for this endpoint; undocumented behaviour is logged as SPEC GAP instead.

description.content: Data-driven collection covering all 56 reviewed-usable FR-08 cases (51 AI-origin after the human audit plus the 5 student-selected extensions). One iteration per canonical case, driven by FR08-checkout.data.json. Optional phases (second user, second checkout, cart rebuild) are skipped per row with pm.execution.skipRequest. Harness notes: implementation cart state is process memory keyed by user id, POST /api/cart only appends, and no cart-clearing endpoint is documented, so each case registers its own fresh user to obtain a deterministic empty starting cart. The expected total is never hardcoded: it is derived at run time from the cart state the server itself reports immediately before each checkout, which is exactly the reviewed FR-08 oracle. No HTTP status code and no response schema is asserted anywhere, because the API specification documents none for this endpoint; undocumented behaviour is logged as SPEC GAP instead.

One iteration per canonical case, driven by FR08-checkout.data.json. Optional phases (second user, second checkout, cart rebuild) are skipped per row with pm.execution.skipRequest. Harness notes: implementation cart state is process memory keyed by user id, POST /api/cart only appends, and no cart-clearing endpoint is documented, so each case registers its own fresh user to obtain a deterministic empty starting cart. No HTTP status code and no response schema is asserted anywhere, because the API specification documents none for this endpoint; undocumented behaviour is logged as SPEC GAP instead.

description.content: Data-driven collection covering all 56 reviewed-usable FR-08 cases (51 AI-origin after the human audit plus the 5 student-selected extensions). One iteration per canonical case, driven by FR08-checkout.data.json. Optional phases (second user, second checkout, cart rebuild) are skipped per row with pm.execution.skipRequest. Harness notes: implementation cart state is process memory keyed by user id, POST /api/cart only appends, and no cart-clearing endpoint is documented, so each case registers its own fresh user to obtain a deterministic empty starting cart. The expected total is never hardcoded: it is derived at run time from the cart state the server itself reports immediately before each checkout, which is exactly the reviewed FR-08 oracle. No HTTP status code and no response schema is asserted anywhere, because the API specification documents none for this endpoint; undocumented behaviour is logged as SPEC GAP instead.
